For a full deployment, install both.'); Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $out 'INSTALL_SET_README.txt') -Value $readme -Encoding utf8; $manifest=[ordered]@{version=$version; createdAt=$created; entries=@(@{target='admin'; label='GymKiosk Admin'; installerName=[System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($adminDst); installerPath=$adminDst; hash=$adminHash; hashFilePath=$adminDst+'.sha256.txt'}, @{target='kiosk'; label='RDP-GYM Kiosk'; installerName=[System.IO.Path]::GetFileName($kioskDst); installerPath=$kioskDst; hash=$kioskHash; hashFilePath=$kioskDst+'.sha256.txt'})}; $manifest | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content -Path (Join-Path $out 'install-set-manifest.json') -Encoding utf8; Write-Output "INSTALL_SET_READY:$out"
